name: Banh gai Nam Dinh
summary: A black glutinous-rice cake filled with mung bean, coconut, fat, lotus seed, and peanut. Thế giới tiếp thị calls the filling fragrant, rich, and sweet-nutty.
origin: Nam Định, as a gift, on the Nam Định city portal on 17 October 2018 and Dân Việt on 5 September 2025.
taste: Thế giới tiếp thị calls the filling fragrant, rich, and sweet-nutty.
seoTitle: Banh gai Nam Dinh — black sticky cake
seoDescription: Black glutinous-rice cake filled with mung bean, coconut, fat, lotus seed, and peanut, a Nam Định gift.
